name: blockchain-anomaly-ai
description: Real-time blockchain anomaly detection with AI-powered narratives — Reboot 2026

scripts.bootstrap: npm run install:python && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:blockchain
scripts.install:python: npm run install:backend && npm run install:llm
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:llm: cd llm-narrative-server && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,llm,frontend -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run llm-server" "npm run frontend"
